description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Power BI Developer / Data Visualization Analyst based in the United States. 

 The Power BI Developer / Data Visualization Analyst will develop and maintain business intelligence solutions supporting Army data center operations, enterprise IT asset management, and government IT contract performance. This mid- to senior-level role focuses on transforming complex operational data into accurate, actionable, and auditable dashboards and reports. You will build data models, KPI scorecards, and performance visualizations that provide visibility into infrastructure health, asset lifecycles, service delivery, and contractual compliance. Working closely with government and contractor stakeholders, you will translate technical and operational requirements into reliable reporting products. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to mission-critical IT operations while strengthening data quality, accountability, and informed decision-making.



Accountabilities:
 
 You will lead the development and maintenance of Power BI reporting solutions, ensuring that operational, infrastructure, asset-management, and contract-performance information is accessible, accurate, and meaningful. You will collaborate with technical teams and program stakeholders to establish reporting standards, identify performance issues, and support continuous operational improvement.


 
 
 
 Power BI development: Design, develop, test, publish, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, and datasets supporting data center operations and IT asset accountability.







 
 
 
 Infrastructure and asset reporting: Build reporting solutions covering servers, storage, network devices, virtual infrastructure, racks, power equipment, software, licenses, and other data center configuration items.







 
 
 
 Asset lifecycle management: Track assets throughout their lifecycle, including receipt, inventory, assignment, installation, movement, maintenance, warranty, refresh, disposal, and retirement.







 
 
 
 Contract performance and compliance: Develop KPI scorecards and compliance dashboards covering service-level agreements (SLAs), Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements, deliverable status, and corrective actions.







 
 
 
 Operational performance measurement: Monitor inventory accuracy, lifecycle compliance, maintenance completion, ticket response and resolution times, service availability, configuration compliance, vulnerability remediation, and other approved performance metrics.







 
 
 
 Data traceability: Create drill-down reports that connect KPI and SLA results to supporting service tickets, asset records, maintenance activities, outage data, configuration-management records, and other source information.







 
 
 
 Data integration and transformation: Integrate, transform, and reconcile information from approved asset-management systems, configuration-management databases (CMDBs), ticketing platforms, inventory tools, network-monitoring systems, endpoint-management solutions, and vulnerability-management platforms.







 
 
 
 Data modeling and optimization: Develop and optimize DAX measures, Power Query/M transformations, and SQL queries to ensure reliable and high-performing reporting solutions.







 
 
 
 Data quality management: Identify and report data-quality issues, including duplicate or missing asset records, incomplete serial numbers, inconsistent device names, incorrect locations, missing ownership information, and conflicting configuration data.







 
 
 
 Exception and risk reporting: Develop reports highlighting overdue maintenance, expiring warranties, unsupported equipment, end-of-life assets, missing inventory records, missed SLAs, overdue deliverables, and other compliance risks.







 
 
 
 Stakeholder collaboration: Work with program managers, contracting officer's representatives (CORs), data center leads, system administrators, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, configuration managers, and contractor teams to gather and validate reporting requirements.







 
 
 
 Documentation and governance: Maintain documentation covering data sources, report logic, metric definitions, data-quality checks, refresh processes, user access, and known reporting limitations.







 
 
 
 Operational reviews: Support monthly operational reviews, contract-performance reviews, leadership briefings, status reporting, and corrective-action tracking.







 
 
 
 Training and mentorship: Provide technical support and user training while mentoring junior analysts and report developers.







 
 
 
 Security and compliance: Ensure all reporting products follow applicable security, access, information-handling, records-management, and release requirements.








 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate is an experienced business intelligence or data analytics professional with strong Power BI development capabilities and an understanding of enterprise IT operations. You should be comfortable working with complex operational datasets, translating contractual and technical requirements into measurable indicators, and communicating reporting insights to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.


 
 
 
 Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant additional experience may substitute for a degree where permitted.







 
 
 
 Professional experience: 5–8 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, IT operations reporting, IT asset management, configuration management, or a related field.







 
 
 
 Power BI experience: 3–5 years of hands-on Microsoft Power BI development experience.







 
 
 
 Power BI expertise: Advanced proficiency with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, and Power Query/M.







 
 
 
 Data and database skills: Strong knowledge of SQL, relational databases, dimensional and relational data modeling, data reconciliation, validation, and quality analysis.







 
 
 
 Microsoft tools: Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.







 
 
 
 Reporting experience: Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, KPI scorecards, SLA reports, or compliance reporting solutions for IT operations, managed services, enterprise infrastructure, or similar environments.







 
 
 
 IT infrastructure knowledge: Experience supporting data center operations, enterprise IT infrastructure, server environments, networks, storage, cloud or hybrid-cloud environments, or IT service-management functions.







 
 
 
 Operational data sources: Experience working with IT asset-management platforms, CMDBs, help-desk and ticketing systems, endpoint-management tools, network-monitoring platforms, vulnerability-management systems, or similar sources.







 
 
 
 Contract performance reporting: Ability to translate contractual performance requirements, PWS requirements, SLAs, and operational standards into measurable reporting criteria.







 
 
 
 Communication: Strong ability to explain technical issues, data limitations, and performance results to technical teams, program leadership, and nontechnical stakeholders.







 
 
 
 Documentation and collaboration: Excellent requirements-gathering, documentation, stakeholder-engagement, and cross-functional collaboration skills.







 
 
 
 Security clearance: Active Department of Defense (DoD) Secret clearance or higher is required.







 
 
 
 Citizenship: U.S. citizenship may be required depending on contract or system-access requirements.







 
 
 
 Preferred certification: Microsoft PL-300: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification.







 
 
 
 Preferred government experience: Experience supporting Army IT services, data centers, enterprise infrastructure, managed-service contracts, government program-management offices, CORs, service delivery managers, or technical contract-management teams.







 
 
 
 Preferred platforms: Familiarity with ServiceNow, BMC Helix, Remedy, Jira Service Management, or comparable IT service-management and asset-management platforms.







 
 
 
 Preferred data technologies: Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, SQL Server Integration Services, or similar data-integration tools.







 
 
 
 Power BI governance: Experience with workspace administration, row-level security, deployment pipelines, controlled data-refresh processes, and report lifecycle management.







 
 
 
 IT service-management metrics: Familiarity with incident response and resolution, ticket aging, backlog, availability, maintenance compliance, configuration compliance, inventory accuracy, and asset lifecycle reporting.







 
 
 
 Cybersecurity reporting: Familiarity with patch compliance, vulnerability remediation, endpoint status, and configuration exceptions.







 
 
 
 Government contract practices: Understanding of quality assurance, deliverable tracking, corrective-action plans, and contract-performance reviews.








 Benefits :


 
 
 
 Paid holidays.







 
 
 
 Paid time off (PTO).







 
 
 
 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.







 
 
 
 Medical and health insurance plans.







 
 
 
 Dental insurance.







 
 
 
 Vision insurance.







 
 
 
 Life insurance coverage.







 
 
 
 Disability benefits.







 
 
 
 Reasonable accommodations are available
